title: cephalaria elata
intro: Cephalaria elata, commonly known as the Goat's Beard, is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cephalaria elata include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation and have antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
